I answered Pree in a thread on her #central-team message: the store was **Pine Crossing**.

On June 9 she posted in #central-team that Pine Crossing's morning receiver saw only the afternoon shift on the appointment screen. A driver arrived at 7:10 and staff wrote his trailer number on a sticky note. Hollis said he'd check the shift template and ask support to reproduce the problem with the store login. I found no later update on it in that channel.
